title: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (NYSE: UNH): Post-Shock Margin Recovery, Star-Rating Overhangs & Stage 2 Institutional Re-Rating
holding_rationale: UNH is currently NOT_HELD across all tracked US brokerage accounts (equities and options). No existing position requires trimming or exit management; new capital should scale via staged tranches inside the $391.99–$408.40 support shelf with a hard invalidation stop at $386.02.

holding_alerts.instruction: Initiate Tranche 1 (7 shares, ~50% of 14-share / 6.5% NAV Tier 2 cap, within 75 bps = $665 risk budget) on dips into $391.99–$402.36 (10W EMA / 50D SMA shelf) once FY26 guidance confirms >= $20.50 adjusted EPS floor.
Cancel pending buy orders or exit any newly opened position on a daily/weekly close below $386.02 (below 50D SMA and 30W SMA support).
Re-evaluate valuation and trim 25%–33% into strength if UNH reaches $475.00 without commensurate 2028 Star Rating recovery.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal cash unit (UNH is NOT_HELD; $7,434.75 consolidated cash available across US accounts)

destinations.rationale: The US market regime is in Correction (below 50-DMA, above 200-DMA, 6 distribution days, 52.6% breadth > 50-DMA). Retaining 50% cash preserves dry powder for a deeper pullback toward $392–$400 or broader index stabilization.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy remaining 50% cash into UNH Tranche 2 on a confirmed bounce off $392–$400 or upon US regime returning to Confirmed Uptrend.

destinations.recommendation: Allocate 50% to AvePoint (AVPT) on Stage 2 Support
destinations.rationale: AVPT offers pure-play enterprise SaaS compounding (16.8% ROIC, zero funded debt, $495.1M ARR +27% YoY) in a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend (+8.3% from 10W EMA) without UNH Medicare Advantage Star Rating or DOJ regulatory overhang.
destinations.entry_condition: Accumulate AVPT in $15.05–$16.50 support zone (CMP $16.55) with invalidation stop at $12.47.

destinations.rationale: Although ELV trades at a lower 14.21x forward P/E vs UNH 17.39x, ELV carries lower ROIC (6.85% vs UNH 9.52%) and weaker operating margin (3.81% vs UNH 5.32%) without Optum Insight/Rx scale.
destinations.entry_condition: Remain 0% allocated unless ELV demonstrates sustained ROIC > 9% and relative strength leadership over UNH.

primer: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) is the largest US integrated healthcare platform with $447.57B in FY2025 revenue . It pairs UnitedHealthcare's 48.3M medical members with Optum's care delivery, health-IT, and pharmacy services . After a 2025 margin shock, 2026 operating earnings recovered to $23.54B through nine months . We assign a New-Capital Verdict of ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP (TIER_2) at $407.46 inside the $391.99–$408.40 support shelf, while UNH remains NOT_HELD in current US accounts .
